name: Parent dashboard (read-only via share code)
acceptanceCriteria: An invalid /parent/<bad-code> route shows a 'Share link revoked' or 404-style gate
A valid /parent/<code> page shows a heading with the student's label and a 'read-only' indicator
The page shows an Overall readiness tile with a big composite number and 5 pillar bars
The page has 4 subsections: Profile, Recent interviews, Essays, Activities
antiPatterns: Login redirect fires for the /parent/ route (it must be public)
